title: Execute audited Radio component polish
description: Implement Radio audit findings after modularization, including single-choice indicator, reset behavior, icon support, and state styling.
objective: Make Radio visually and behaviorally distinct from Checkbox and Chips.
acceptance_criteria: Radio does not look like a checkbox with a different input type.
Only one option can be selected per group.
Reset and URL sync behavior remain predictable.
verification: PHP lint, JS syntax, CSS check, WP-CLI harness, and line-budget guard pass.

budgets.validation_budget: mechanical checks plus Guilherme visual QA

risks: Radio can become redundant with Chips if the selected affordance is not clear.
